home.report: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

home.name: Terry McLaurin
home.report: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

home.name: Charles Omenihu
home.report: questionable

home.name: Javon Kinlaw
home.report: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.

home.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste
home.report: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.

away.name: Saquon Barkley
away.report: Barkley said after Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys that his "hamstring came out great," and noted that the back issue that kept him out for the entire fourth quarter isn't anything that he expects to prevent him from playing Sunday against the Commanders, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.

away.name: Dameon Pierce
away.report: Pierce didn't take the field for either of the Eagles' final two possessions of Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys after sustaining an undisclosed injury with 8:38 remaining in the fourth quarter, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

away.name: Britain Covey
away.report: Covey (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's contest versus the Cowboys.

away.name: Jakorian Bennett
away.report: Bennett (knee) will remain on injured reserve and is inactive for Monday night's matchup with Dallas.
